known_boundaries: Appraisal scores are coverage-aware, assessor-entered indicators, not probabilities, GRADE certainty ratings or validated risk-of-bias scores.
Unknown methodological dimensions remain not_reported; not_applicable dimensions are explicit and excluded from coverage.
Reproducibility profiles record reported artifact availability and replication status; submitted code/artifacts are not executed and reproduction is not independently certified.

Calibration requires binary outcomes, minimum sample counts, unique opaque disjoint train/holdout IDs, and non-degraded holdout Brier/ECE. These checks do not prove external cohort independence, label correctness, representativeness or future validity.
A calibration non-degradation gate is not a statistical significance test.
Quality-gated hypotheses remain drafts; provenance and review do not establish causal or scientific validity.
Live PostgreSQL, production concurrency/load, full monolithic suite and formal security/static audits remain outstanding.
